prompts.animation:
Create one continuous 4-second locked wide shot based strictly on the supplied Start Frame. The six exact characters remain standing in their established positions for the entire take. They must not walk, change places, turn their bodies, raise or lower their arms, shield their heads, gesture, speak, celebrate or perform any other significant movement. Allow only nearly imperceptible natural breathing, tiny eye movement and minimal wet-clothing or hair response to the weather. Preserve every face, pose, hand position, body proportion, wardrobe, spacing and silhouette exactly as shown in the Start Frame.

Animate ONLY the individual Delicje that are already visibly present in the supplied Start Frame. Every existing biscuit continues falling downward from its exact starting position, tumbling gently with realistic lightweight biscuit physics and its existing motion direction. Maintain strict object conservation: the number of biscuits at the beginning of the take must equal the number visible in the Start Frame. ABSOLUTELY NO NEW BISCUITS MAY APPEAR ANYWHERE AT ANY TIME. Do not spawn biscuits above the frame, in the sky, behind the building, between characters, near the lens or after an existing biscuit leaves the image. Do not duplicate, multiply, replace or transform any biscuit. As the already visible biscuits fall below the bottom edge or land out of view, the air naturally becomes emptier; the rain of biscuits does not intensify and does not continue.

Keep the camera completely locked with no pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, crane, reframing, shake or cut. Preserve the ruined Dom Kultury, collapsed Belicosa, rubble, signs, rain, lighting and background exactly. No returning fleet, new destruction, repair, magic pulse or environmental change. All biscuits remain the exact referenced Delicje with one pale sponge base and one smooth chocolate cap: no black sandwich cookies, white cream, packages, logos, morphing, subtitles or watermark.
